key_sections.name: Hero Principal
features: Kinetic line-by-line headline reveal with Framer Motion
Subtly animated floating decorative badges (4,7 ★ Google Trust)
Primary CTA button: 'Llamar al 695 33 20 60' with phone icon and direct tel: link
Secondary CTA: 'Ver Carta Artesanal' smooth scroll to menu
Editorial marquee ticker below hero featuring seasonal flavors and craft coffee notes

key_sections.name: Barra de Confianza & Historia Local
features: Highlighting 4,7 stars over 46 reviews in Valdemoro
Stat cards with micro-hover lift
Mention of Centro Comercial El Restón

key_sections.name: Nuestra Carta Artesanal (Menú)
features: Interactive tab switching with smooth layout transitions
Dietary indicators (Sin gluten, Vegano, Top Ventas)
Appetizing product grid with image zoom effect on hover

key_sections.name: Galería de Fotos del Local y Productos
features: Bento style asymmetrical photography grid
Modal lightbox zoom when clicking any photo
Filters for 'Ambiente', 'Helados', 'Cafetería'

key_sections.name: Reseñas & Opiniones de Nuestros Clientes
features: Cards simulating Google 4,7 star reviews
Reviewer avatars, star ratings, and authentic local quotes from Valdemoro families & neighbors

key_sections.name: Contacto, Horarios y Ubicación
features: Highlight: 'Abierto hoy hasta las 22:00'
Full address with direct Google Maps link button
Interactive phone action callout
CC El Restón location callout with parking & accessibility details

testing_and_data_attributes.rule: Every interactive, link, button, section, tab, phone link, and key statistic MUST contain a clear data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page app with sticky top navigation and section scrolling.
Use warm artisanal cream & espresso color scheme. Avoid harsh tech cold colors.
Include an SVG replaced logo for Charlotte's Coffee & Ice Cream.
Ensure click-to-call functionality links to tel:+34695332060.
Prominently highlight the 4.7 stars based on 46 reviews and open status until 22:00.
Use Framer Motion for scroll reveals and kinetic text transitions.
Provide responsive layouts for mobile and desktop screens.
